mechanism: Zoledronic acid causes hypocalcemia and electrolyte disturbances (hypophosphatemia, hypomagnesemia) that increase digoxin sensitivity and arrhythmia risk, while renal impairment from zoledronic acid reduces digoxin clearance.
action: Monitor serum calcium, magnesium, and phosphate levels closely; measure digoxin levels before and after zoledronic acid infusion; adjust digoxin dose if renal function declines; monitor ECG for arrhythmias.
